mapper.select: SELECT r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location, GROUP_CONCAT(h.hashtag) AS hashtags FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner_id, type, img_url, rep_img_yn FROM image WHERE type = 'review' AND rep_img_yn = 'Y' ) i ON r.id = i.owner_id JOIN hashtag h ON r.id = h.review_id GROUP BY r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location

SELECT r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location, GROUP_CONCAT(h.hashtag) AS hashtags FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner_id, type, img_url, rep_img_yn FROM image WHERE type = 'review' AND rep_img_yn = 'Y' ) i ON r.id = i.owner_id JOIN hashtag h ON r.id = h.review_id WHERE r.id IN ( SELECT review_id FROM hashtag WHERE hashtag = #{hashtag} ) GROUP BY r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location
